build.beforeDevCommand: deno task build && cargo build -p mailbrus-server && cp -f target/debug/mailbrus-server src-tauri/binaries/mailbrus-server-$(rustc -vV | sed -n 's/host: //p') && ./target/debug/mailbrus-server --bind 127.0.0.1:1371 --frontend-dist ./build
build.beforeBuildCommand: deno task build && cargo build -p mailbrus-server --release && cp -f target/release/mailbrus-server src-tauri/binaries/mailbrus-server-$(rustc -vV | sed -n 's/host: //p')

security.csp: default-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:1371 ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:1371 asset: http://asset.localhost blob: data:; style-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:1371 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:1371 'unsafe-inline'; frame-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self';
